purpose: Record local source-context review for all 48 C2-LT-B1 source extraction rows. This register verifies that the extracted rows are structurally ready to enter independent fresh review, while keeping Source Card promotion, reviewed artifacts and model admission blocked.

scope.selectionRule: Review every C2-LT-B1 source extraction row after field extraction and before independent fresh review, card promotion or any model-admission consideration.
currentLimitations: This is a local structural and source-context review, not independent fresh review.
This register does not validate external source claims, evidence grades, clinical recommendations, effect sizes or model calibration.
Rows can move to independent fresh review, but they cannot move to Source Card promotion or reviewed artifacts until fresh-review verdicts exist.
No row admits calibrated prediction, individual advice, individual death-date output, intervention ranking, clinical-validity claim or domain-claim upgrade.

localReviewChecks: Every reviewed task is present in the source extraction queue.
Every reviewed task has a completed extraction row in the source extraction register.
Every extraction row preserves exact claim use, endpoint, population or setting, mechanism or effect, uncertainty, transfer boundary, downgrade triggers and model position.
Every extraction row keeps model admission blocked and prohibited uses complete.
Every local domain path exists and exposes README.md and AGENTS.md.
The register explicitly routes the batch to independent fresh review before Source Card promotion.

reviewBatches.reviewLabel: 急性高风险与慢性转移域
reviewBatches.nextReviewMode: independent fresh review must verify source identity, guideline/currentness boundaries, endpoint specificity and transfer limits before artifact promotion

reviewBatches.reviewLabel: 代谢、体能、神经与运动连续性域
reviewBatches.nextReviewMode: independent fresh review must verify measurement boundaries, disease heterogeneity, function endpoints and subject-continuity safeguards before artifact promotion

reviewBatches.reviewLabel: 肿瘤控制、抗菌韧性与免疫基础设施域
reviewBatches.nextReviewMode: independent fresh review must verify screening recommendation scope, cancer-site specificity, pathogen or vaccine specificity, surveillance quality and access boundaries before artifact promotion

reviewBatches.reviewLabel: 肝脏、新生儿、生殖选择、疼痛、屏障和患者安全域
reviewBatches.nextReviewMode: independent fresh review must verify programme indicators, screening follow-up, consent and storage governance, functional outcomes, implementation fidelity and safety-event measurement before artifact promotion

nonClaims: This register is not an independent fresh review verdict register.
This register does not complete any reviewed Source Card, variable card, endpoint card, uncertainty card, transfer-boundary card or downgrade-check artifact.
This register does not validate external source truth, clinical recommendations, intervention effects, calibrated risks or individual prognosis.
This register does not authorize calibrated prediction, individual advice, individual death-date output, intervention ranking, domain-claim upgrade or clinical-validity claims.
indexRequirements: README.md must link this register near the C2-LT-B1 source extraction register.
